message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard's legend maps pale yellow to the high end of the Hazard H risk index (High/100) and dark burgundy to the low end (Low/0). Among the three options, ME is filled pale yellow, indicating the highest risk index, while OK and TX are dark burgundy, indicating the lowest. A priority hazard review list is logically intended to target the state with the highest hazard risk. Therefore, ME is the correct selection.", "option_label": "Select ME for priority review"}
